paraphrase: At the end of guru yoga the practitioner receives the four empowerments: from the guru's forehead (oṃ) white light purifies the body and gives the vase empowerment; from the throat (āḥ) red light purifies speech and gives the secret empowerment; from the heart (hūṃ) blue light purifies mind and gives the wisdom empowerment; and from all three the fourth, the word empowerment; then guru and disciple mingle and one rests in the nature of mind.
notes: Reference from the unit author's knowledge (not read in a local text in this phase).
